tier1Signals.description: Act within 4 hours — these companies are in active buying mode

signals.details: New office address confirmed. They have a move-in date and a fitout deadline.
signals.typicalTimeline: Furniture decisions needed within 8–14 weeks of lease signing
signals.action: Call or personalised email within 48 hours. Lead with free layout plan offer.

signals.details: Company is formally seeking quotes. They have budget approval and a decision deadline.
signals.typicalTimeline: Decision within 2–4 weeks of RFQ close
signals.action: Submit highest-quality response. Be first to submit. Include 3-tier pricing.

signals.signal: Referral from existing TCD client or partner
signals.details: Trust already transferred. Close rate is 2–3x higher than cold enquiry.
signals.action: Personal call within 2 hours. Acknowledge the referrer. Fast-track to strategy call.

signals.signal: Inbound enquiry with budget confirmed >$50,000 and move date
signals.details: Self-identified, budget-confirmed, timeline-ready — the ideal lead
signals.action: Personal call within 1 hour. Treat as Priority 1.

tier2Signals.description: Act within 24 hours — these companies are likely planning office changes

signals.signal: Series A or larger funding announcement
signals.details: Fresh capital typically funds team growth and office upgrade within 3–6 months
signals.action: LinkedIn outreach to CEO/Operations with workspace planning framing

signals.signal: Significant hiring surge (5+ roles/month for 3+ months)
signals.details: Growing headcount will exceed current office capacity — space event likely
signals.action: Outreach framed around 'growing companies we work with' — not a cold pitch

signals.signal: Company announced move to new city or interstate expansion
signals.details: New market entry requires a local office setup
signals.action: Outreach within 72 hours — they have no local supplier relationship yet

signals.signal: Job posting for 'Office Manager' or 'Facilities Manager' (new role, not replacement)
signals.details: Indicates company is formalising operations — likely at a growth inflection
signals.action: Contact company HR or operations team — mention timing of role creation

tier3Signals.description: Nurture — potential buyers but no immediate decision
signals: General company growth articles without specific office mention
Joining a coworking space (precursor to own office)
tier3Signals.action: Add to LinkedIn connection + email nurture sequence. Set 3-month reminder to re-evaluate.
